d:
Daya playfully teases Jethalal by comparing his face to a bull (Bailji). Offended, Jethalal tells her to tape her mouth shut to keep quiet—which she actually does. When Bapuji catches them, he mistakenly believes Jethalal is torturing Daya and punishes him before Daya clarifies the confusion.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
